ACL-02.rationale: Inbound payloads are validated at the API gateway, outside this repository; the rule stays as a reminder while the gateway contract is migrated in. A waiver of a blocking criterion: approver AND expiry are required.

ACL-04.rationale: ACL versioning is tracked in the platform release train, not per repository. A severity downgrade of a blocking rule: an approver is required, no expiry.

TAX-04.rationale: This repository is generated code where the naming convention is the generator's. A non-blocking rule: a rationale is enough.

SSDF-PS.3.2.rationale: Example Corp publishes an SBOM for every release and holds itself to it. Hardening is always allowed.
